appearance.reviewMethod: Viewed all28 actual captures in labelled contact sheets; additionally inspected residential, commercial and narrow production at native resolution.
findings: No new blocking legacy road appearance regression was seen relative to ca586/profile6. The runtime assets are unchanged and the new captured road appearance remains matte.

Near residential, commercial and narrow inspections retain terracotta faces with fine pores/grain, small installed-level variation and localized thin edge/contact shadows. No new glass-like pale wash, broad trenches or raised-plate regression appeared.

Seven fixed diagnostic PNGs are wholly pixel-identical to ca586. Normals and environment-specular each differ by one1LSB channel at one sky pixel near the top (641,86 and586,71), outside the pavement; these differences are explicitly recorded.
The12 translation/turn captures show continuous fitted paving without an obvious rectangular streaming seam, ownership cut, broad flash or altered brick identity.
Existing mild pixel-broken/dotted contacts remain near some edges. Filtered middle/orbit/overview views convey little individual physical volume when unresolved.
limits: The12 lossless motion samples are sparse; this review does not establish universal FPS or every high-frequency temporal frame.
Coverage fractions are recomputed from recorded counts; full original per-sample readiness/depth state is not serialized for independent replay of every coverage decision.
The five control assertions come from the exact fingerprinted browser harness; intermediate full camera snapshots are not serialized.
Root owns independent strict12timing, complete regression, global acceptance and publication gates.

findings: The new ordinary 1.4 m residential/commercial views retain matte terracotta and thin shallow near contacts. The matched original-BRDF sun-facing control retains the pale grazing wash; the matte view does not acquire that wash.
No new raised plates, broad open trenches, source-edge clipping, cut mismatch or rectangular streaming seam was observed in the reviewed new captures.

At middle/far distances the road reads mainly through filtered colour variation and subtle contacts. Narrow 2.4 m views remain explicitly filtering-only and do not establish visible resolved volume there.

Mild dotted or pixel-broken nearest contacts remain visible, especially residential wide 1.4 m. The distant transverse residential scene/design line remains aligned with lot boundaries across road and sidewalks.
The eight reviewed translation/turn frames show no obvious flash or rectangular tile seam; this sparse sequence cannot establish high-frame-rate temporal stability.

All 50 newly downloaded controlled captures are byte- and pixel-identical to actual ca586 captures; eight production and eight motion images have small cross-run differences. This supporting comparison does not substitute for the direct new-build review.
limits: This component review does not accept full-site performance, legacy controls, final staging or publication.
Weak narrow 2.4 m middle/far depth and mild nearest-contact aliasing remain documented appearance limitations.
The canvas captures do not show the 100 px welcome bar; separate browser/header checks own that validation.

secondReview.scope: All21junctions and7controls reviewed independently; full-resolution19/20/mobile/flight2; see exact file set in that record

findings: All 33 road-domain views retain warm matte terracotta faces with restrained per-piece variation. Near pieces show thin bevel highlights and shallow contact shading; no broad glass-like wash is visible in these settled views.

All 21 junction views retain a continuous fitted pattern. The ten header-course domain views show their intended narrow transverse/center courses and changed adjoining orientations; no rectangular streaming-block seam or unexplained hole in paved source interiors was found.

Curved source curbs, cut ends and commercial access footprints retain clean paving termination. White pedestrian crossing/design fills remain over the paving, including COM-4, COM-5 and commercial junction20; these are not untextured gaps.

COM-2 visibly retains the building shadow across the pavers. The surface continues into shade without losing the red pattern; private-depth/occlusion preservation is established by the fingerprinted native audits rather than inferred from this shadow picture. Bright sunlit areas remain lighter than shaded areas, as expected.

The prominent green line through 40E1-0 and across junction2 and12–18 is the retained Utilities source feature SP19_RED_SANITARIA:4DE, handle4DE. Exact source-ring projection places it through those inspection targets within2.6e-10m; it is a design overlay rather than missing paving.

The parallel distant bands in junction20 match the pedestrian-crossing feature COT_P3_CEBRAS:cruce_a_nivel. Nearby source crossing polygons lie roughly3.04m and3.79m ahead of that inspection target and span the road; their green source outlines remain visible.

Detail-disabled retains the filtered street finish, and the final desktop capture returns to the normal Fly control after narrow-screen and flight checks. The three flight frames show progression with the Release control active and no visible detached tile or flash in those sampled frames.
The welcome bar remains visible above the map in full-page desktop and mobile images. Mobile retains its collapsed measurements control and usable map controls.
limits: Fine near contact edges retain mild dotted or jagged aliasing, especially at strong contrast and in building-shadow penumbrae. This review does not claim elimination of all aliasing.
Distant paving is filtered toward a flatter colour pattern; these steep-down settled road-domain views supplement, and do not replace, the separate ordinary forward-flight and toward-sun captures.
The material remains an illustrative game-rendered finish with fairly clean faces, not an exact photographic reproduction of the mockup.
Static captures cannot establish continuous high-frame-rate temporal stability or universal device performance. No global release acceptance is granted by this component review.
